confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Bucharest prices, rolled forward to July 2026; not checked against live menus, booking pages or listings. Restaurant and coffee anchors are moderate confidence; hostel and hotel rates are least certain given seasonal and property variation. Beer assumes a local 0.5 L draft. Cocktail and wine anchors rely mainly on the local beer price relationship because direct knowledge is weaker. FX 0.7002 (RBA 4pm, 2026-10-14) comes from search-result summaries of rba.gov.au pages; the F11.1 table itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Informal benchmark against Central and Eastern European capitals of similar size and tourism profile, such as Sofia, Belgrade, Budapest and Warsaw.
